newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Data backs investment outlook - Australia govt.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Data backs investment outlook - Australia govt.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday recent information confirmed the government's strong investment projections.
"Recent partial information remains consistent with a very strong investment outlook, particularly for non-residential construction in the Australian economy," Costello told parliament.
Costello pointed to high levels of activity in the non-residential building sector, engineering construction and record investment in resource-related projects.

"In an environment of low inflation and low interest rates, with sound corporate profitability and a healthy rate of return on capital stock, this kind of business investment is expected to continue," he said.
"This is strong business investment which has not been seen in Australia for some time. It is business investment in relation to resource projects, infrastructure projects, non-residential dwellings.
"It is sound business investment in a sound and growing economy."

The Libera-National government, in its mid-year review of the budget and economy, revised its estimates of business investment growth up to 17 percent from 14 percent, made in last year's August budget.
